title: PPIA-15 Integrated Expanded Regression Workflows / Traceability Package Index
gates: One stable integrated workflow and one genuinely compositional integrated case exist for each of the 18 required awkward families.
All 24 stable scenario contracts, 12 Inspector projection groups, 20 action/reference contracts and 12 authority/presentation handoffs are covered.
All 32 Foundation and 40 IAR cases are assigned exactly once across workflows; all 18 integrated cases are assigned exactly once, yielding 90 effective PPIA-15 cases without count inflation.
Permission/entitlement filtering, stable identity, minimum disclosure and hidden/missing equivalence precede protected derivatives and action availability.
Status unknown is not failure; accepted Event remains distinct from projection; offline/local state remains nonauthoritative; blind ambiguous mutation retry remains forbidden.
Case-local 512 inventory and 128 Creature/NPC fixture sizes remain QA inputs only, not product capacity/performance promises.
PPIA-11 analysis remains uncertainty-bounded and cannot certify balanced/fair/safe/winnable/optimal/guaranteed outcomes.
Ordinary GM modification remains inherited with zero standalone PPIA-15 clones; only stale-version composition is additive.
P15-GAP-001 / F024 remains open and unsupported; no Pack lifecycle behavior is invented.
Dedicated hosted validation plus all applicable regressions must pass on one exact pull-request head before merge.
completion_effect: Intermediate PPIA-15 milestone only. This package does not by itself complete PPIA-15.
